title: 第4章 反击
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

时间仿佛凝固，死亡的压迫让林珝忘记了呼吸。

直到一抹凄厉的破风声，撕裂了夜的寂静。

乌勒人的箭矢快如流星，几乎是眨眼就逼近了后背。

林珝知道躲不掉，更来不及躲。

千钧一发之际，他几乎是凭借身体的本能，猛地朝左侧一扑，同时微微侧身。

弩矢带着强劲的惯性，擦着肩胛骨狠狠钉入地面，溅起一捧泥土，打得他脸颊生疼。

这是真正的、足以致命的危险！

好在几十步的距离，让弩箭的准头差了几分，没能精准地命中他要害。

饶是如此，肩膀被犁开的那道伤口，依旧传来一阵令人头皮发麻的剧痛，像是被烧红的烙铁摁了上去。

“嘶——”

刺痛感如毒蛇缠身，林珝却死死趴在地上，一动不动。

乌勒人的马蹄声已然近在咫尺。

这个距离，对方随时可以再补一箭，跑起来只能是白送！

林珝索性装死，把脸埋进泥土里，假装自己被一箭贯穿。大脑却疯狂运转，飞速盘算着反击的策略。

右手悄悄攥紧了刀柄，左手不动声色地抓了一把沙土。

身后，乌勒斥候翻身下马。

这家伙显然对自己的箭术极为自负，甚至懒得再补一箭，随手将弓弩往马背上一挂，反手拔出腰刀，冷笑着朝“尸体”走来。

天赐良机！

林珝紧贴地面，腰腹蓄力，耳朵贴着泥土，细数着乌勒人的脚步声——

十米……八米……五米……

夜色朦胧，影响了乌勒斥候的视线。

当他走到不足三米的地方时，才终于警觉地停下脚步。

随后他发现，刚才那一箭根本没有射穿目标的要害。

上当了！

乌勒斥候瞳孔骤缩，急忙抬手，准备补刀。

就在这一刻，林珝动了！

左手猛地扬起，一把沙土如同漫天乌云，劈头盖脸地糊在对方脸上。

乌勒斥候厉声叫骂，本能地丢开弓弩，仓促挥刀格挡。

“去死！”

林珝抓住机会，翻身暴起，积蓄已久的腰刀后发先至。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Time seemed to freeze, and the oppression of death made Lin Jue forget to breathe.

Until a shrill sound of wind broke the silence of the night.

The Ule people's arrows were as fast as meteors, approaching their backs almost in the blink of an eye.

Lin Jue knew that he couldn't hide, and he didn't have time to hide.

At the critical moment, almost relying on his body's instinct, he suddenly pounced to the left and turned slightly sideways.

With strong inertia, the crossbow arrow hit the ground hard against his shoulder blades, splashing up a handful of dirt and hurting his cheek.

This is a real and fatal danger!

Fortunately, the distance of dozens of steps made the crossbow miss a few points, and it failed to hit his vitals accurately.

Despite this, the wound on the shoulder that was opened by the plow still caused a numbing pain, as if it had been pressed with a red-hot iron.

"Hiss——"

The stinging sensation was like a poisonous snake, but Lin Jue lay on the ground motionless.

The sound of the Ule people's hooves was already close at hand.

At this distance, the opponent can add another arrow at any time, but running away will only be in vain!

Lin Jue simply pretended to be dead, buried his face in the soil, and pretended that he had been pierced by an arrow.But his brain was running wildly, quickly calculating counterattack strategies.

His right hand quietly clenched the handle of the knife, and his left hand calmly grabbed a handful of sand.

Behind him, Scout Uler dismounted.

This guy was obviously very proud of his archery skills. He didn't even bother to add another arrow. He casually hung the crossbow on the horse, pulled out his sword with his backhand, and walked towards the "corpse" with a sneer.

God-given opportunity!

Lin Jue stayed close to the ground, accumulating strength in her waist and abdomen, and put her ears to the soil, counting the footsteps of the Ule people——

Ten meters...eight meters...five meters...

The hazy night affected Scout Uler's vision.

When he was less than three meters away, he finally stopped in alarm.

Then he discovered that the arrow just now did not penetrate the target's vital point at all.

Fooled!

Scout Ule's pupils shrank suddenly and he hurriedly raised his hand, preparing to strike again.

At this moment, Lin Jue moved!

The left hand was raised suddenly, and a handful of sand was like a dark cloud in the sky, covering the opponent's face.

Scout Uler screamed and cursed, instinctively threw away his crossbow, and hurriedly swung his sword to block.

"Go to hell!"

Lin Jue seized the opportunity, turned over and violently rose up, and the long-prepared waist knife came first and second.
